paragraphs.text: Renalt was a Quirion bard who encountered Jared Carthalion in the White Woods of Casindral , part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .
Renalt wore a low-plunging gray-violet dress, held a lyre, and had long brown hair and a leather headband.
Renalt welcomed Jared Carthalion into the Quirion sovereign, and shared with him a tale describing the power of green magic.
Renalt’s song in Wayfarer #2 is heavily influenced by Irish poetry.
